title: Ext is computed by the signed dual Koszul cohomology
statement: Let A be a commutative ring whose module category has a derived category, I an ideal, and f:Fin r -> A a Koszul-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence] generating I. There is an A-linear equivalence Ext^r_A(A/I,A) -> H^r(L), where L is the signed dual Koszul complex [def-sc-koszul-dual-complex]. This assertion does not mention the conormal module or a determinant identification.

source.place: Lemma 48.15.5, computation of derived Hom by a finite free Koszul resolution

proof.text: Construct the quotient augmentation of the Koszul complex. The image of d_1 is I, hence degree zero homology is A/I; higher homology vanishes. Each term has the finite exterior basis, so this is a projective resolution.

Apply Mathlib ProjectiveResolution.extEquivCohomologyClass to this resolution and A. A cocycle into A[0] has a single component in nonnegative degree n, namely a functional on K_n. Its total Hom differential is (-1)^(n+1) times precomposition with d_(n+1). Identifying that component identifies cycles, coboundaries and their quotient with homology of the signed dual complex, A-linearly. Take degree r.
